concerns.text: The implementation plan does not reference any of the contract schemas (e.g., `dataset.schema.yaml`, `phenology_metric.schema.yaml`, `gamm_results.schema.yaml`, `trajectory.schema.yaml`). According to the cross‑doc consistency rule, each contract should be exercised by at least one plan element (e.g., validation of downloaded data against `dataset.schema.yaml` or schema‑checking of model outputs against `gamm_results.schema.yaml`). Add explicit steps that validate inputs/outputs against the defined contracts.
